Implement the Verilog module based on the following description. Assume that signals are positive clock/clk edge triggered unless otherwise stated.

Correct the syntax error in the code.

Reply with the complete corrected module in a ```verilog code block.

Problem Description:
Build a circuit that has one 3-bit input, then outputs the same vector, and also splits it into three separate 1-bit outputs. Connect output o0 to the input vector's position 0, o1 to position 1, etc.

module top_module(
	input [2:0] vec, 
	output [2:0] outv,
	output o2,
	output o1,
	output o0
);

Erroneous Implementation:

always @(posedge clk) begin
	outv <= vec;
	o2 <= vec[2];
	o1 <= vec[1];
	o0 <= vec[0];
end
endmodule
